answer: Locks are logged in quill, expire in pulse, and forge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 187 aliases hence needs 184 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1601 identities would post 1331 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
